sections.heading: Boundary
paragraphs: Approved 2026-07-01. Stage 1 scope covers Mumbai headquarters, corporate endpoints and staff-operated support processes.
AWS Mumbai production accounts and the customer-facing HRFlow application are excluded from the Stage 1 boundary pending cloud-control evidence reconciliation. They host the live customer service.

sections.heading: Ownership
paragraphs: The three-person security team reports to the CTO. The privacy officer works two days per week and reports separately to legal.
